Genre (Optional): Horror (Not sure what else to put it as)

Elevator Pitch: Old Man Jefferson runs a little shop. His very presence seems to put people on edge, and he apparently has everything in this little shack. Every so often he slips up, revealing a terrifying something beneath.

Central Narrative: An entity with the power to overthrow gods who owns a little shop, something straight out of a story. It looks like an old man, but in the interviews and experiment logs he shows this power, only accidentally sometimes.

item.title: Seeking greenlighting (or something idk i'm new here)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): ???

Elevator Pitch: So basically, it’s a brandless watch that has a digital clock, sets an alarm and has a timer. It has some anomalous properties in it’s functions. The clock, when reset, will turn back time to when the current user first found the watch/scp, meaning that if it is taken off and put back on again, the original encounter will be when the watch turns back time to. The alarm function, if at set time, will instantly give the current user a boost of energy and, if asleep, will instantly wake them up. The timer has two main anomalous functions. When stopped, if the timer has already been started, time will be stopped until the timer is started again. In this time, the user can move around freely and perform many actions. If the timer is restarted, time will go back to when the timer was about to start. If the user wears it for more than 2 weeks, the watch/scp will attach itself onto the user and the user would be unable to take it off, as it is now part of the body. Further testing has not been done.

Central Narrative:The scp was originally located in a watch store and it was then given to the scp foundation after complaints from customers reporting that their friends and family were acting weirdly and returned it after symptoms showed. The watch then went onto the possession of many people, though they returned it soon after realising it’s anomalous capabilities. In one case though, a D-class got hold of it and tried to use the timer to escape once they realised what it did, and then they tried to stop time and escape [REDACTED], but they were too slow and the guards there quickly terminated them. After this, testing with the scp will only be tested with trusted D-class and trusted Researchers. One test of this was when Dr. [REDACTED] first tested it. The test consisted of testing it’s capabilities if it will regenerate lost limbs, wounds or scars. Dr. [REDACTED] volunteered for testing and endured great pain. From testing, it’s found out that when using the timer to reset or using the clock, the harm done to the user’s body will have a black line around the perimeter of the wound, scar or lost limbs, slightly differing between types of harm. This is an indicator if anyone has used the scp.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I don't really know this is really the first time I’m doing something like this.

Additional Notes: This is my first time here/writing.

item.title: SCP - Kraken Mare
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Science Fiction

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP article.

Elevator Pitch: There's an alien ecosystem in Kraken Mare, the largest of Titan's liquid methane seas. The anomaly is that the life there isn't really alien at all - all the organisms there are copies of marine life from Earth's Cretaceous seas, modified on the chemical level to survive Titan's conditions but unchanged on the macro scale. So rather than aliens swimming in methane, there are mosasaurs and ammonites instead.

Central Narrative: The central narrative is the mystery of how prehistoric animals ended up living on Titan. The Foundation first found the anomaly when a NASA probe to Kraken Mare got eaten - containment focuses on keeping information from getting out rather than doing anything on Titan itself. Eventually the Foundation sends another probe to explore Kraken Mare. The exploration log ends with a plinth on the seafloor that lists the surface liquids and basic biochemical reactions found on Earth, Titan, and an unknown third world with sulfuric acid seas. The implication is that aliens copy-pasted an ecosystem from one liquid medium to another, and did the same elsewhere, for reasons unknown.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think it's a fun mix between aliens and dinosaurs, combining real-life sea monsters with exotic hypothetical biochemistry. The story also ends with the revelation that powerful anomalous beings once came to Earth and, for once, did something pretty benign.

Additional Notes: I'm thinking about having the plinth be written in Ortothan, just to tie the SCP into something bigger and make it feel more connected to some other space SCPs.

item.title: Men Are Expendable
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight : No (not yet)

Page Type : SCP Article

Genre : Drama

Elevator Pitch : An SCP that allows a woman to get pregnant without having any sexual intercourse with a man. The activation of the SCP’s abnormal properties requires a sacrifice consisting of human blood, water and animal bones. The SCP “steals” another woman's pregnancy in order to make the user pregnant, and children born this way might be “special”.

Narrative : (( I want to use the idea of fertility and pregnancy, and put it as the central abnormal effect of this SCP. This idea is inspired by an old African legend, in which a young infertile woman, Akua, was given a doll that would supposedly help her get pregnant ; which it did, or at least according to the legend. The doll was transmitted from woman to woman, and disappeared after some time. ))

+ show block
– hide block

The Foundation received reports of a secret tribe located somewhere in Africa, in which men and women were showing incredible physical and mental abilities (strength, logical thinking and great charisma). Its inhabitants didn’t show any sign of hostility towards the SCP Agents that were sent to the place.

Upon investigating, the Foundation discovered that the tribe worshipped a wooden doll. Thanks to the efforts of The Foundation’s Translators, the agents were able to engage in a discussion with the aborigens, and discovered the abnormal effects of the doll.
The resulting births and “procreation” within the tribe were hence caused by the impact of the SCP’s abnormal effects : all of the inhabitants claimed to have a woman as their parent, and the idea of a father seemed strange to them.
It was peculiar that the tribe was so sophisticated and well-developed, despite being isolated from the rest of the world (complex language, irrigation systems…).The way it managed to remain hidden, as well as its history remains unknown.

The wooden doll was recovered [stolen] by the Foundation in order to study its anomalous properties. This led to a battle, resulting in a total termination of the tribe’s members.

Hook/Attention-Grabber : I find this SCP interesting because it deals with the subject of fertility in a curious way.

Additional Notes : N/A

item.title: SCP: Older Brother (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Mystery

Elevator Pitch: The first anomaly is a child in a hazmat suit who's composed of 40% of the same materials found in a hydrogen bomb. The child was discovered in an abandoned town in Northern Russia after reports of unusual levels of radiation.

Due to being highly radioactive, the Foundation but him in a secure steel room. Even with its suit, contact with it results in severe radiation poisoning. The anomaly appears to have 3rd degree burns across its body, although it claims to suffer no physical pain from the burns.

The child also carries a backpack with 10 out of ordered issues of the Incredible Hulk.

It claims that it was left behind by their "older brother" in the town. It also talks about how its "Mother" used to care for them but she soon died forcing the two to depart for a new home.

The older brother is the second anomaly. It is an entity described to have "white noise" and " a dark figure". The entity only appeared once to take back the hazmat child due to the Foundation's "mistreatment" of them. The entity emits extremely high levels of radiation even in a 1-mile radius. It also affects electronic devices and signals rendering them dysfunctional. The entity also seems to have a psychic connection to the child, demonstrated when the child warns the Foundation that he is coming to pick him up.

Central Narrative: A foundation researcher will interview the child and will learn things about his older brother and Mother. But as the interviews go on, it becomes increasingly that the child keeping secrets. The child will eventually alert the Foundation that their "older brother" will take them due to disliking how the Foundation is handling him. This will lead to an incident that causes the deaths of multiple personnel including the researcher who interviewed the child.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:I want this SCP to have layers of mystery like where these two came from and who "Mother" is within the interviews the child has with the researcher. But I also want to keep it vague enough to be left to interpretation. The older brother anomaly will also be shown through an incident log.

Additional Notes:

  • Their origins might be linked to Russian nuclear testing
  • The child is older than it seems
  • There's an important correlation between the Incredible Hulk comic and the pair that will be expanded on

item.title: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-#### “The Predatory Tattoo” is entity in the form of a tattoo usually appearing to look like a predatory creature ranging from several present day predators to extinct/unknown species. It primarily targets individuals with atleast 3 or more tattoos but will on rare occasions appear on individuals with little to no tattoos. At first it’ll just be seen as a tattoo that the victim wouldn’t seem to have any memory of getting it. As time goes on the victim will notice slight imperfections with the tattoo, such as it seeming to be out of place and its eyes seeming to be looking up. Claw mark-like tattoos over existing tattoos/bare skin that seem to sting as would normal claw marks would also appear. Eventually it would kill its victim in the way the predator its based off would normally kill its prey (bruises associated with being constricted being tattooed on the victim or gashes from claws as well)

Central Narrative: the anomalous entity would first be discovered after the latest victim in a string of murder was brought to the attention of the foundation. Agents disguised as Federal agents would confiscate the recent body as well as all files on previous victims. After transferring the corpse to a foundation facility, one of the retrieval agents would discover an tattoo of unknown origin on his back after feeling a stinging sensation and seeing the scp taking the form of extinct species of Kaprosuchus. After the agents death from the scp, the skin of the agents back was removed, preserved and placed in a frame with the scp still in place with physical contact being heavily restricted to prevent containment breaches.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The ‘ink’ comprising of both the scp and the wounds it inflicts would contain partial dna mixed in with the normal content of the tattoo ink. Its main way of hunting would appear to try and make its prey paranoid all the while it toys with its prey.

Additional Notes: As stated, normal means one would take to remove a tattoo does not seem to work with the person attempting to remove the entity reporting feeling unnerved and/or receive tattooed markings in the form of self defensive slashes or bites

item.title: Random Access Memory
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A USB flash drive that teleports from one data storage device to another

Central Narrative: A usb stick jumps from storage device to storage device to download random files. The usb stick starts out first with things like computers and servers, but changes to more forms of data storage, such as phones, alarm clocks, vending machines, electronic locks, and eventually brains. As it jumps from device to device, it attaches itself to anything that would contain data rather than to a port. This causes problems as, when it jumps, it will deform anything around it in order to fit into the device. This might mean cracking a casing or pushing away brain tissue. The usb stick was first found by an on-site tech repair team while examining a broken computer. Initially, it is relatively easy to contain by putting it into a secure storage locker, as it so far has only chosen computers. Containment becomes more complicated as it begins to attach itself to the electronic locks, cameras, and even occasionally other scps. Containment becomes vital when the usb begins to cause fatalities by inserting itself into brains. Eventually the containment consists of an empty room with one DC voltage light and a mechanical locked door with a viewing port and a telescope. New usbs with random data are pulled in via a pulley system using only rope and a hand crank. The nearest telephone is a rotary phone with no data storage whatsoever. Due to its lethality, researchers weren’t able to come up with an explanation as to what the USB’s function is, or where it came from.

**Additional Notes:* I don't know if i should add more detail to the over all story on this post. It would mostly be the foundation slowly losing control over the scp until the end.
